Sin embargo, lo que más llamó la atención fue su recibimiento, digno de un auténtico rey: alfombra roja, todo el auditorio puesto en pie y una ovación a la altura de una leyenda. Y es que Messi es mucho más que uno de los mejores futbolistas de la historia. Su grandeza no se mide únicamente en goles, títulos o récords, sino también en todo lo que ha transmitido fuera del campo. Su humildad, su trabajo y unos valores que han inspirado a generaciones enteras demuestran que detrás de su talento siempre hubo muchísimo esfuerzo. Porque hay deportistas que hacen historia por lo que consiguen, pero muy pocos logran dejar una huella tan profunda en millones de personas. Y si algo quedó claro en Oviedo, es que Leo Messi no solo se ha ganado el respeto del mundo del fútbol, sino también el reconocimiento de todo el deporte. Vía/ @Absolutemessi

Messi at Barcelona was never just a player wearing the shirt; he was a story of magic and greatness that will never be repeated in the history of football. He was an extraordinary phenomenon who made the impossible look easy and turned every match into a masterpiece. Every time he touched the ball, the world waited for something special: dribbles that left defenders helpless, unbelievable goals that took everyone’s breath away, and passes that revealed a level of genius possessed by no one else. He never needed strength or noise to prove his greatness, because his feet spoke for him, and football became a pure form of art whenever the ball was at his feet. From historic Champions League nights to legendary El Clásico battles that captivated the world, Messi was always the man who made the difference and wrote history when others could do nothing. He gave Barcelona fans some of the most beautiful moments of their lives and created memories that will remain unforgettable no matter how many years pass. Numbers and trophies alone can never describe what he accomplished, because his impact went far beyond statistics. He became a symbol of loyalty, creativity, and greatness, and one of the biggest reasons why Barcelona is loved by millions around the world. No matter how many new stars emerge, what Messi achieved in a Barcelona shirt will always remain extraordinary. Some players win matches, others make history, but Messi did both. He left behind a legacy that will be incredibly difficult for anyone to match. He was more than just a legend; he was the player who made us fall in love with football all over again, turning every moment we watched him into a memory worth telling to future generations. Messi was never just a Barcelona legend; he was the very definition of football greatness and the soul that gave this club some of its most glorious years. His name will forever be engraved in the history of the Blaugrana, and the number 10 shirt will always stand as a symbol of an era that will never be repeated. Barcelona had many great players, but in Messi, they possessed something truly irreplaceable. Once a Culer, always a Culer. Visca Barça! Visca Messi!  #messi
